ApiKeyRateLimited.description: The API key exceeded its rate limit or usage quota. Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying. The X-RateLimit headers are sent only when the rate limit was hit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Omitted when an exhausted usage quota never refills.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the API key may make per window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window resets.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code. Derived from the status unless a more specific code applies, such as VALIDATION_ERROR or MISSING_PERMISSION.

path.description: Dotted path to the invalid input, prefixed with the request part (body, query, params, header).

missingPermissions.description: Permissions the caller lacks for this route, as resource:action, for MISSING_PERMISSION and API_KEY_SCOPE.

target.description: The one entry the request named that was refused, such as an import source's database ID, when the request named several.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

subtaskCounts.description: Direct subtasks in the workspace; completed means a final column in the child project. Public boards count only children in public projects.

metadata.description: Provider-specific payload, already parsed from the stored JSON string.

relatedRevision.description: Public board labels and external links revision for this task page. Restart pagination if it changes during related-page continuations.

revision.description: Public board content, membership and ordering revision, including related records and visible subtask progress. Restart pagination if it changes between task or related pages.

BoardPagination.description: Always paginated: 50 tasks by default, at most 100 per page. Continue through totalPages to retrieve all tasks. For each task page, follow relatedPage through relatedTotalPages to retrieve all labels, external links and columns (100 related rows per kind per request, plus up to 100 columns needed to represent the tasks).

descriptionDeferred.description: True when a project description above 64 KiB is omitted; use project detail or public project description pages for full text.

hasImageUploads.description: Whether S3-compatible storage is configured, so task images and board backgrounds can be uploaded.

customOAuthName.description: Label for the custom OAuth provider on the sign-in page. Null means the generic SSO label.

redirect.description: Where to send the browser next: back to the client with a code on approval, or with an error on denial.

idToken.description: The stored id_token for the user's `custom` OAuth account, or null when they have no such account.

slug.description: Short prefix used in task identifiers, e.g. KAN-12.

isPublic.description: When true the project's board is readable without signing in, via /api/public-project/{id}.

archivedAt.description: Non-null once archived; archived projects are hidden by default.

lastTaskNumber.description: Highest task number issued in this project; the next task gets this plus one.

dueDate.description: The soonest due date among the project's open tasks.

total.description: All open tasks assigned to the caller, including any beyond the first 100 returned.

status.description: The slug of the column the task sits in.

statusName.description: The column's display name. Null for tasks outside a column, such as planned ones.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

key.description: Object key to send back to the finalize route.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned URL to PUT the image bytes to.

headers.description: Headers that must accompany the upload request, including Content-Type.

url.description: Where the stored image can be read back from.

columnId.description: The referenced workflow column; null for virtual statuses and legacy tasks without a column reference.

labels.description: Label names and colors, without their ids.

tasks.description: Per-task outcome, each carrying a success flag.

slug.description: Stable identifier derived from the name; tasks store this as their status.

position.description: Board order, ascending. Columns are always returned sorted by it.

isFinal.description: Marks the column as a done state, which stops overdue reminders for tasks in it.

type.description: One of: comment, task, create, status_changed, priority_changed, assignee_changed, unassigned, due_date_changed, title_changed, description_changed.

eventData.description: Type-specific payload. For status_changed, oldStatus/newStatus are slugs and oldStatusName/newStatusName carry current configured column names when available.

excerpt.description: Plain-text preview of the stored content, at most 240 characters: the comment body, or the description older system events carry instead of eventData.

externalUserName.description: Set when the activity was imported from another tool.

externalSource.description: The tool it was imported from: planka, trello, jira, plane, linear, kaneo, or a connected forge such as github.

userId.description: Null once the user who logged the time has been removed.

endTime.description: Null while the timer is still running.

duration.description: Elapsed seconds, filled in once the entry has an endTime.

content.description: Free-text body. Null for generated notifications, whose text the client renders from type and eventData.

resourceId.description: The id of the task or workspace the notification points at.

dueDateReminderLeadTimeMinutes.description: How long before a due date the reminder fires, in minutes.

workspaces.description: Per-workspace overrides. A workspace with no rule follows the global settings.

repositories.description: Repositories the caller administers, deduplicated within the response.

threadId.description: Forum topic id, when the target group uses topics.

relationType.description: How the two tasks relate: `subtask`, `blocks`, or `related`.

target.description: The card (number, title, project) or sector (name) the request is about; null when it is gone or the caller cannot open its project.

mirrored.description: Notion is the source of this card's Notion fields: it came from a Notion page and the mirror runs for the workspace (R-081). They are read-only while true.

kind.description: task: title, description, status, priority, assignee, dates. meta: the card fields.

revision.description: task edits: the revision the edit replaced.

actorId.description: The agent or t-boards session behind the edit; null for a person's edit on kaneo's routes (kaneo's activity names them).

revision.description: task rollbacks: the card's revision after it.

mirrored.description: Notion is the source of this card's Notion fields: it came from a Notion page and the mirror runs for the workspace (R-081). They are read-only while true.

lease.description: The live lease, if someone works on it now.

approvals.description: Pending requests for the owner's «да» on this card, newest first, at most 10.

direction.description: outgoing: this card is the relation's source (it blocks, it is the parent).

relations.description: Linked cards the caller can see, at most 20.

comments.description: The latest comments, newest first, at most 20.

history.description: The latest edits, newest first, at most 10: which fields changed, not the values (those are in the card history).

truncated.description: Sections that had more than the pack holds; read them in full from their own endpoints.

available.description: false when the claude-mem worker is unreachable and nothing was cached yet.

stale.description: true when the worker is down and the list is a cached copy.

scanned.description: How many of the latest observations were checked.

matchedValue.description: The card's branch or identifier the observation names.

configured.description: true when this workspace is the one the scheduled mirror writes to.

streak.description: Clean runs in a row, newest first, with no gap longer than maxGapHours (AC-003).

read.description: Pages Notion returned; of them, pages without a card and pages Notion edited since the last run.

discrepancies.description: The first 200 discrepancies; discrepancyCount has them all.

latest.description: The newest finished run's full report.

branchCount.description: Subtasks under the root, at any depth.

truncated.description: More than 100 trees; narrow by project.

rootId.description: The root of the card's tree, the card itself when it has no parent; null when the root is in a project the caller cannot see.

ancestors.description: Parents from the root down, visible ones.

subcards.description: Subcards under this card at any depth, and how many are done.

tree.description: The same for the whole tree under the root.

taskId.description: The card the session works on; null when none.

step.description: What the session is doing now, in a sentence.

waiting.description: What the session waits for: a review, an answer, a run.

holder.description: Who holds the card's lease now.

session.description: The latest session whose working state names the card.

executor.description: Who the card's fields say did or does the work.

severity.description: How bad the bug is, as its card records it.

type.description: subtask, blocks and related join cards (source → target); file and decision join a card to its node.

key.description: The key itself, shown once; the server keeps only a hash.

harness.description: The harness the session runs in, as a lowercase slug: claude-code, codex, continue, cursor, kimi, copilot, roo or your own.

session.description: What the session calls itself (letters, digits, spaces and . _ : / # @ + -, up to 80). Without it the agent is named after the harness.

disabledAt.description: When the owner disabled the agent; a disabled agent gets no keys until the owner enables it.

archivedAt.description: When the agent went to the archive after a day without activity, or was enabled from disabled. An archived agent holds no keys and no place under the cap, and comes back when its session asks for a key.

archived.description: The agent is in the archive: it comes back when its session asks for a key.

header.description: The request header an MCP client names its role in.

extraMax.description: Tools a session may take beyond its role over its whole life.

embedded.description: Chunks embedded with the current model.

changed.description: False when the text matched the stored sha256.

cards.description: Cards the notebook holds after the sync.

changed.description: Cards whose text changed and were cut again.

pruned.description: Card sources removed: the card is gone, archived, or in a project not every member may open.

changed.description: False when the fetched text matched the stored one.

mode.description: The ranking actually used for this answer.

configured.description: False: answers carry sources without written text.

status.description: Assistant turns only. answered is a written answer; retrieval-only, capped, rate-limited and failed carry the sources without one. brief is a GOAL/CONSTRAINTS/ACCEPTANCE brief of the thread, brief-failed a brief call that returned none.
